footnotes.footnote: 1:2 The Hebrew term *hebel*, translated *vanity* or *vain*, refers concretely to a “mist,” “vapor,” or “mere breath,” and metaphorically to something that is fleeting or elusive (with different nuances depending on the context). It appears five times in this verse and in 29 other verses in Ecclesiastes
1:13 The Hebrew term denotes the center of one’s inner life, including mind, will, and emotions
1:14 The Hebrew term *hebel* can refer to a “vapor” or “mere breath” (see note on 1:2)
1:14 Or *a feeding on wind*; compare Hosea 12:1 (also in Ecclesiastes 1:17; 2:11, 17, 26; 4:4, 6, 16; 6:9)
